code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low pO₂, low O₂ saturation), mild leukopenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, CRP, and INR, and mild basophilia. These findings suggest acute respiratory failure with systemic inflammation and coagulopathy, possibly due to severe infection or inflammatory process. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
